item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
Lumary Audio 1.4
Lumary Audio now keeps itself up to date.
• It looks for a new version once a day and tells you on the device when there's one. Click UPDATE to download it, then INSTALL AND RELAUNCH to switch over. LATER asks again another day.
• Check for Updates… in the app menu looks right away. Settings > General turns the daily check off or on.
• It never interrupts a recording: an update found while a tape is running waits, and one that finishes downloading then installs when you quit.
• Every update is signed, and checked against that signature before it installs.
If you installed with Homebrew, brew upgrade still works too.
Requires macOS 26 or later.
